dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Chunguza mpangilio wa mishono, rangi za nyuzi, miruko, upunguzaji, na amri za mashine kabla ya uzalishaji. Ona muundo shono kwa shono, badilisha mitindo ya kuonyesha, na hamisha unachokiona.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Uigaji wa mwingiliano wa ushonaji, ukaguzi, na usafirishaji.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Shikilia rula dhidi ya skrini na buruta kitelezi hadi upau ulio chini uwe na urefu wa mm 100 haswa, kisha bonyeza OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Nakili picha ya mwonekano kamili kwenye ubao wa kunakilia

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Lugha imewekwa kuwa {language}. Anzisha InkSim upya sasa ili itumike?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Lugha ya mfumo itatumika. Anzisha InkSim upya sasa ili itumike?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Windows zote za InkSim zilizo wazi zitafungwa na faili ya sasa itafunguliwa upya.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_failed.translation: Uhamishaji wa CSV wa Ink/Stitch umeshindwa.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Tazama output.err kwa maelezo ya hitilafu.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Muda wa kusubiri kuona mshono umeisha.

dialog.open_browser.converting.translation: Uhamishaji wa CSV wa Ink/Stitch unaendelea...

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Fungua SVG hii kwenye dirisha jipya la Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Hakuna faili zinazotumika kwenye folda hii.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Bofya folda mara mbili ili kuvinjari faili zake.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Bofya folda mara mbili ili kuvinjari faili zake.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Inkscape inahitajika ili kuhariri faili za SVG.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Usakinishaji wa Ink/Stitch uliosanidiwa na kizindua cha Python vinahitajika.

dialog.open_browser.not_embroidery.translation: Hii si faili halali ya embroidery

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Tengeneza data ya mishono kutoka kwenye SVG hii ukitumia Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Haiwezi kuendesha hati hai ya Ink/Stitch au kizindua chake cha Python kilichosanidiwa.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Kiendelezi cha Ink/Stitch: hakikuweza kukaguliwa. Tumia Zana... kujaribu tena.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Kiendelezi cha Ink/Stitch: hakikupatikana kwenye saraka za viendelezi za Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Kiendelezi cha Ink/Stitch: hakiwezi kukaguliwa hadi Inkscape isanidiwe.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Kiendelezi cha Ink/Stitch: bado hakijakaguliwa. Tumia Zana... kukikagua.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Chanzo cha SVG. Inkscape inahitajika ili kuhakiki mishono.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Chanzo cha SVG. Chagua Hakiki ili kutengeneza data za mishono kwa kutumia Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: SVG hii ni kubwa mno kuweza kuhakikiwa hapa.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Imeshindwa kuunda faili ya muda ya hakikisho: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Aina hii ya faili haiwezi kufunguliwa katika InkSim.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Imeshindwa kuhifadhi hali ya kiendelezi cha Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Hakuna folda za viendelezi vya InkSim zilizopatikana.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Imeshindwa kukagua folda za viendelezi vya Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Imeshindwa kusakinisha viendelezi vya InkSim vya Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Viendelezi vya InkSim vya Inkscape vimesakinishwa au kusasishwa katika {path}. Anzisha upya Inkscape ili vipakie.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape haikupatikana kwenye njia ya mfumo.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Imeshindwa kusoma saraka za viendelezi vya Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Anzisha upya Inkscape ili kutumia kikalimani kipya cha Python.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Ondoa nakala za zamani za InkSim

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Imeshindwa kuondoa folda ya zamani ya kiendelezi cha InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Folda za zamani za viendelezi vya InkSim zimeondolewa. Anzisha upya Inkscape ili kuonyesha upya orodha yake ya viendelezi.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Usanidi uliotambuliwa umehifadhiwa kwenye usanidi wa InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Imeshindwa kukagua folda za viendelezi vya InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape haikupatikana. Chagua programu yake ili ukague usanidi.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Imeshindwa kukagua au kusasisha kikalimani cha Python: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Mapendeleo ya kikalimani cha Python hayakukaguliwa kwa sababu saraka ya viendelezi vya mtumiaji haipatikani.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Anzisha upya Inkscape ili kutumia kikalimani kilichosasishwa.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Chagua programu ya Inkscape ili ukague.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape haikujibu ndani ya sekunde {seconds}. Huenda mawasiliano yanazuiwa na kikao kingine cha Inkscape au kiendelezi. Funga vikao vingine vya Inkscape au zima kiendelezi kinachozuia mawasiliano, kisha ujaribu tena.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Kizindua kinachohitajika '{command}' hakikupatikana. Sakinisha zana ya uvr mwenyewe kwa kutumia `uv tool install uvr`, kisha endesha usanidi huu tena. InkSim haitaisakinisha.

menu.view.save_snap.translation: Hifadhi nafasi ya sasa ya snap

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Hakuna faili la embroidery lililopakiwa la kuhamisha.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Weka upya upana wa mstari na vipengele vya kivuli

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Bonyeza kurekebisha kipengele cha giza, kipengele cha mwanga na upana wa mstari

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Mwonekano wa chini (chora mishono ya baadaye chini ya ya awali)

status.mode.density.translation: Badilisha mwonekano wa msongamano wa mishono

status.mode.gpu_textured.translation: Badilisha utoaji wa GPU wenye texture

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Zungusha mwonekano wa miruko: zima, zote, hatari tu
